ceramic.title: Michael Bays Transformers Explodes on Streaming 18 Years Later
ceramic.snippet:
Michael Bay has been involved with some major franchises, with the biggest being  Transformers for Paramount Pictures. Now, 18 years later, the franchise's first live-action/CG movie is blowing up on streaming.

    Transformers is currently ranked in the No. 10 spot on Prime Video's Top 10 Movies in the United States chart , according to FlixPatrol.

 Directed by Bay and executive produced by Steven Spielberg,  the live-action  Transformers movie was released in theaters in 2007, starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox as Sam Witwicky and Mikaela Banes, respectively, who team up with Bumblebee, Optimus Prime, and the rest of the Autobots to take on the threat of the malicious and menacing Decepticons. Despite receiving mixed reviews upon its release,  Transformers was a major box office hit, grossing over $700 million worldwide during its theatrical run.

  Following  Transformers ' commercial success, Paramount quickly moved forward with two sequels — 2009's Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen and 2011's  Transformers: Dark of the Moon — with Bay and LaBeouf returning as director and lead star, respectively.  Dark of the Moon is notable for being the highest-grossing  Transformers movie in history as well as the first one to gross over $1 billion.

   Bumblebee was followed by  Transformers:   Rise of the Beasts in 2023, which was intended to kick off a new trilogy of live-action films. Unfortunately, after  Rise of the Beasts massively underperformed at the box office, the future of the  Transformers franchise remains unclear.  Rise of the Beasts ' ending set up a crossover with Paramount's  G.I. Joe series , which still looks to be moving forward at this time, with Chris Hemsworth attached to star and Derek Connelly penning the screenplay . However, Bay is reportedly interested in returning to helm a new  Transformers movie , having already tapped Jordan VanDina to write the script. It is unknown at this time which project Paramount plans to make first.
